bank_name: South Bangla Agriculture & Commerce Bank PLC
period_note: SOLO/STANDALONE basis, unaudited. HALF-YEARLY filing -- balance sheet is the 30-June-2025 period-end snapshot (reported), compared against 31-December-2024 (audited). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2025 (the statement's own 'Ol Jan 2025 to 30 June 2025' column). The filing also prints a discrete 'Ol April to June 2025' (Q2-only) column; the three most decision-relevant discrete-quarter figures are captured below as supplementary *_discrete_quarter fields, consistent with 2025_Q3.json's convention. CROSS-REPORT VALIDATION: this file's H1 cumulative PAT (113,818,276) minus this bank's own 2025_Q1.json PAT (109,505,419) reproduces the discrete Q2 PAT printed in THIS report (4,312,857 vs printed 4,312,858, i.e. within Tk.1 rounding) -- confirming Q1 and Q2 filings are mutually consistent. Separately, 2025_Q3.json's 9-month cumulative PAT (117,694,376) minus this file's H1 PAT (113,818,276) reproduces 2025_Q3.json's OWN printed discrete-Q3 PAT (3,876,100) EXACTLY -- a three-way cross-validation across three independently-issued quarterly filings. Quarter-by-quarter PAT for FY2025 is therefore: Q1 Tk.109.51m, Q2 Tk.4.31m, Q3 Tk.3.88m, and (annual FY2025 PAT of Tk.6.50m minus 9-month cumulative of Tk.117.69m) an implied Q4 LOSS of approximately Tk.111.19m -- i.e. profitability collapsed almost entirely after Q1 and never recovered. ASSET QUALITY: classified loans (Note 8.11, Solo) rose from Tk.14,332.62m (31-Dec-2024, matching this bank's existing FY2024 record exactly) to Tk.15,490.46m (30-Jun-2025); NPL ratio rose from 16.37% (Q1) to 16.98% (+0.61pp in Q2 alone; +0.81pp cumulative since 31-Dec-2024's 16.17%), following the +0.20pp seen in Q1 per 2025_Q1.json, and itself smaller than the +2.82pp jump seen in Q3 per 2025_Q3.json's 19.80%) -- confirming the NPL deterioration accelerated progressively through the year (Q1 mild, Q2 moderate, Q3 severe, Q4 marginal). The loans-and-advances-only provision shortfall (Note 8.10) similarly accelerated: Tk.6,558.39m (31-Dec-2024) to Tk.6,556.94m (31-Mar-2025, essentially flat per 2025_Q1.json) to Tk.7,361.52m (30-Jun-2025, +804.6m in Q2) to Tk.8,019.93m (30-Sep-2025, +658.4m in Q3 per 2025_Q3.json) -- i.e. the shortfall's growth was concentrated in Q2-Q3, not Q1 or (on this loans-only measure) Q4. STRIKING DISCLOSURE: Note 8.10's own footnote in this filing states verbatim 'Maximum allowable provision has been made in current quarter keeping EPS only Taka 0.005' -- i.e. the Bank's own disclosure states that Q2 provisioning was calibrated to the maximum level that would still leave a (barely) positive quarterly EPS, rather than being purely a function of assessed credit risk. This is a direct, bank-disclosed statement of provision/earnings management and is one of the more significant findings in this bank's dataset. The same footnote also restates the Bangladesh Bank forbearance letters already found in 2025_Q1.json/2025_Q3.json's Note 8.10, adding a Q2-specific data point: 'The provision requirement as on June 30, 2025 stood Tk.1255.36 crore against which the Bank maintained provision of Tk.519.21 crore' (matching this file's provision_required/provision_maintained). Capital adequacy (CRAR/RWA/Tier1/Tier2) disclosures are not part of this quarterly unaudited financial statement. NAV comparative for 31-Dec-2024 in this filing (13.40) matches 2025_Q3.json and the audited 2024_Q4.json exactly, further confirming that 2025_Q1.json's own 31-Dec-2024 NAV comparative (13.23) was an isolated error in that one filing (see 2025_Q1.json period_note).
